summary: Silicom Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its Annual General Meeting held June 3, 2026. Shareholders re-elected a director, approved salary increases for the CEO and Chairman, and appointed auditors. Two RSU grant proposals (38,333 to the CEO and 42,000 to the Chairman) were rejected by shareholders. The Compensation Committee and Board subsequently overrode the rejection per Israeli law, approving the CEO's RSUs with a performance-based forfeiture condition tied to achieving at least US$83 million in consolidated 2026 revenues. This is a routine governance update; no special situation is present.
